scope: Manager check of exact owner instructions, source/canon metadata snapshots, selected preserved bytes and passage-reference integrity; not whole-edition linguistic certification.

checks.unlinked_records: Explicitly formal/structural; metadata shapes and record sizes vary across languages.

handoff_repair.finding: Original full OpenLogic commissions supplied verified English sources and native-canon leads but omitted exact recovered locale-canon locators.
handoff_repair.pashto: No Pashto locale was present in the nine recovered textbook lanes; no neighboring-language canon is substituted as Pashto authority.
handoff_repair.required_followthrough: Personally consult relevant originals, reconcile reuse/duplication/irrelevance/supersession, retain local-needs motivations, and do not import stale QA or retroactive consultation claims.

limitations: Not every source record or image was checked: discovery-only records and differing metadata representations are outside the counted byte checks.
Reference integrity cannot prove historical consultation or semantic equivalence.
Owner semantic reviews are principally same-agent source comparisons, not independent native-scholar certification.
No full 722-unit edition is declared complete by this audit.
